_doc: NOT READ by the code. Copy the keys you need into picture_events.json (same folder) when a picture action lands on a different frame after the merge, then run `python mix.py`. Values: a frame (30 fps, may be fractional), a list of frames, the same dict shape as in picture_events_used.json, a BEAT expression ('bust-2', 'S9.a+4'), or null to drop that cue. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Every default and its source formula is listed in picture_events_used.json and at the end of cues.md.
_climb_4_if_CHAR_keeps_its_own_step_rhyt: the tank man's foot contacts on the top flight (default = the score's climb beats 628.5 / 642 / 655.5, rim on 'up' 669)
_stamps_5_if_CHAR_keeps_its_own_cycle: the banker's stamp landings in shot 5 (default = the score's beats 929.1 / 959.4 / 989.6)
_plunk_4: the plumb weight touching the oil in shot 4 (default 705)
_valves_13: the frames a pump worker starts turning a valve wheel (default: shot 13 start + 10, pipes + 18, tankTo + 28; each squeak is moved into the nearest word gap)
_spin_14: the newspaper spin-in: first frame it is seen and the frame it lands on the stand
_horn_1_if_no_ship_in_frame: drop the far ship horn if WORLD-EXT's harbour has no ship in the shot-1 pull-out
